data.title: Crypto Crash Aftermath: What’s Next For Bitcoin, Ethereum And XRP Prices?
data.description: The worst of the selling may have slowed, but the crypto market is not out of danger yet. After a week of heavy losses driven by hot US inflation data and a tech stock rout, Bitcoin is sitting on its final major support zone.
